entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.Text.Json source generator does not handle collision of nested classes #49747
  • Microsoft.NET.RuntimeIdentifierInference.targets insist on win-AnyCPU on a MAUI/Win.UI project #49744
  • `dotnet workload restore` runs into "Unhandled exception: The imported project..." #49742
  • Templates missing from `dotnet new list` #49741

Closed

  • Cannot publish self contained of an exe that references another exe project #10316
    Backlog
  • the -d parameter doesn't provide me with diagnostic information #10309
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Create .vsconfig #49746
  • Remove MSBuild hacks for virtual project building #49745
    Area-run-file
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49740
    Area-CodeFlow

Merged

  • push version and info command activation into the Option definitions #49664
    Area-CLI, Area-Workloads
  • Eliminate windowsdesktop, wpf, and winforms version elements #49722

Updated

  • make containers net472 target resilient to incorrectly-determined DOTNET_HOST_PATH values #49736
    Area-SdkResolvers, Area-Containers, 10.0.1xx
  • Remove interactive special case for logger verbosity in `dotnet run` #47389
    untriaged, Area-CLI
  • Add flag and tests for codesigning single-file bundles targeting MacOS #49697
  • Make `dotnet project convert` interactive #49660
    Area-run-file
  • Cleanup dotnet test #49734
    Area-dotnet test
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #49389

    Area-run-file
